text: dsh-btw 是面向 DSH Web 的命令插件，通过注册 /btw 斜杠命令，让你在 agent 工作期间补充信息而不打断当前轮次。输入 /btw 加说明后，插件会把内容作为普通用户消息加入后续队列；agent 忙时等当前轮次结束再处理，空闲时立即开始新一轮。它还提供 /btw help，并根据 agent 忙闲状态显示确认信息。适合希望保留当前任务进度、又想追加上下文的 DSH 用户。命令服务须由运行配置提供；不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-btw adds /btw to DSH Web. Send a note while the agent is working; it joins the follow-up queue as a user message, delivered after the current turn, or immediately if idle. Use /btw help for instructions. The profile needs the commands service; no extra key or external service is needed.
agent 正在处理任务时，我想追加一句说明，等这一轮结束后再交给它。
DSH 有没有办法发送补充信息而不取消或重启正在进行的工作？
How can I add a follow-up note to my DSH agent without interrupting its current turn?
dsh-btw 的功能「排队补充说明」：使用 /btw <note> 提交文字，内容会作为普通用户消息进入 agent 的后续队列；忙碌时等待当前轮次结束，空闲时立即开启新一轮。
dsh-btw 的功能「帮助与状态确认」：输入 /btw help 查看命令说明；提交有效说明后，会根据 agent 忙闲状态显示已排队或立即处理的确认消息。

dsh-btw README · dsh-btw：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin that adds a human-facing `/btw` ("by the way") slash command for
**queuing a supplementary note without interrupting the agent**.

dsh-btw README · dsh-btw：While the agent is running, you suddenly remember something extra to tell it.
Type `/btw <note>` and keep your train of thought — the note is delivered to the
agent **after** the current turn finishes. The in-progress turn is never
interrupted, cancelled, or restarted.

dsh-btw README · dsh-btw：> **Note — superseded by the official Web app.**
>
> Recent versions of the official DeepSeek Harness **Web app** ship this
> natively. While the agent is running, the composer **queues** whatever you
> type instead of interrupting the turn — press **Enter** to queue, or
> **Ctrl/Cmd+Enter** (or the per-row **Steer** button) to *steer* it into the
> current turn at the next step boundary. Queued messages can also be edited or
> removed before delivery.
>
> That built-in **Queue/Steer** composer covers — and extends — what `/btw`
> does, so you generally **do not need this plugin**. It remains relevant only
> if you want an explicit `/btw` slash command, or if you run a non-Web profile
> where the composer feature is unavailable.
dsh-btw README · Install：```sh
dsh-btw README · from GitHub (works immediately — no npm publish required)：dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/XiaoWind/dsh-btw.git
section: from GitHub (works immediately — no npm publish required)

dsh-btw README · or from npm, once published：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-btw
```

The `dsh plugin` command forwards to `pnpm` inside the `web` profile directory,
then reconciles the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list. Because this
package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, it joins the layer stack automatically.
Restart the Web app after installing.

> The plugin injects the `commands` service, so it activates only in profiles
> that compose a command adapter — the shipped `web` profile does.

dsh-btw README · Update：Pull the latest version of the plugin into an installed profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-btw
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm update dsh-btw` inside the profile directory,
which re-resolves the `github:XiaoWind/dsh-btw` dependency to the latest commit
on the default branch. The lockfile pins a git dependency by commit hash, so a
`version` bump is not required for the update to land. If pnpm has cached an old
git resolution, re-pin it explicitly:

dsh-btw README · Update：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XiaoWind/dsh-btw
```

Restart the Web app after updating — the bundle layer is composed at boot, so a
running Web process does not hot-reload an installed plugin.

dsh-btw README · Usage：| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `/btw <note>` | Queue a supplementary note (any language) for the agent. |
| `/btw help` | Show help. |

The note is added as an ordinary user message, so the model treats it as your
own words and folds it into the task it is already working on.

dsh-btw README · Semantics：- **Never interrupts.** `/btw` appends the note to the agent's *next-turn*
  queue. If the agent is mid-turn, the running turn completes exactly as it
  would have, then the note is handled as the next message. If the agent is
  idle, the note is picked up immediately.
- **Nothing is cancelled or restarted.** The note is a continuation, not a new
  directive. The current objective stays intact.
- **Order preserved.** Multiple `/btw` notes are delivered in the order they
  were submitted (FIFO).
- **Stateless.** There is no persistence: once delivered, a note leaves nothing
  behind, so a restart never replays an old note.

dsh-btw README · Configuration：This plugin has no configuration. The acknowledgement it prints simply reflects
whether the agent was busy or idle at the moment the note was queued.
dsh-btw README · Development：```sh

dsh-btw README · syntax check：node --check lib/index.js
```

The plugin is a single-file ESM Cordis function plugin (`lib/index.js`) with no
build step. It exports `apply`, `inject`, and `name`, and the bundle layer
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts it into the profile composition.
